seo.title: Library — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: Discover books, novels, and educational resources at the Isôoko Community Library in Masoro, Rwanda.

hero.title: Our Library
hero.subtitle: Books, novels, and learning resources open to the Masoro community

page.title: Browse the Collection
page.subtitle: Find your next book — novels, school books, children's stories, and more

visit.title: Visit the Library
visit.text: Come read, study, or borrow a book at the Isôoko Community Center. Our library is free for everyone in the Masoro community.
visit.location: Masoro Community Center, Masoro Sector, Rulindo District

reader.noContent: This book's reading content is being prepared. Please come back soon.

novel.ikirehe: A celebrated Kinyarwanda novel following Kamana as he returns to his home village and learns that rebuilding a community begins with honesty and shared stories.
novel.umukunzi: A moving story about Aurore, a young volunteer in Kigali who discovers that listening to others is the first step toward healing a divided community.
novel.umundi: The internationally acclaimed memoir from the author of The Barefoot Woman — a powerful act of remembrance of a family and a country.
novel.baredfoot: Scholastique Mukasonga's tender portrait of her mother, a barefoot woman who held her family together with quiet strength and love.
novel.ourLady: Set in a girls' boarding school perched above the River Nile, a novel exploring friendship, prejudice, and politics on the eve of great change.
novel.murambi: A devastating novel built on survivor testimonies, examining guilt, memory, and the meaning of justice after the genocide against the Tutsi.
novel.antelope: Jean Hatzfeld's unflinching work of testimony, in which survivors speak about survival, resilience, and the long road back to life.
novel.thingsFallApart: Chinua Achebe's classic of world literature — the story of Okonkwo and the slow crumbling of his world as new influences arrive.
novel.weepNotChild: Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o's moving novel of a boy in colonial Kenya who dreams of schooling while his family is swept into the struggle for freedom.
novel.riverBetween: A novel of a young educated leader trying to bridge two communities divided by a river and by tradition and change in colonial Kenya.
novel.purpleHibiscus: Fifteen-year-old Kambili discovers courage and her own voice as she moves between her father's rigid house and her aunt's warm home in Nigeria.
novel.halfYellowSun: A sweeping epic of love and war set during the Biafran conflict, following the intertwined lives of twin sisters and a dedicated household.
novel.oldManSea: Hemingway's timeless tale of an old fisherman who battles a great fish alone on the open sea — a story of dignity and endurance.
novel.animalFarm: Orwell's sharp and unforgettable fable about the animals of Manor Farm and how a revolution of ideals is slowly betrayed.
novel.alchemist: A young shepherd follows his dream across a desert in search of treasure, and finds that the journey itself is the real prize.
novel.littleWomen: The beloved classic of the four March sisters — Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy — growing up, loving, and supporting one another through joy and hardship.
novel.tomSawyer: Mark Twain's warm, humorous tales of a mischievous boy growing up along the Mississippi and the trouble he so often finds.
novel.treasureIsland: The classic pirate adventure — young Jim Hawkins, a treasure map, and the unforgettable Long John Silver.
novel.hobbit: Bilbo Baggins is swept from his comfortable home into a quest for a dragon's treasure, and comes home a changed hobbit.
novel.lifeLaidBare: A collection of plainspoken testimonies from the lakes region of northern Rwanda — a document of memory and reconciliation.
novel.chosen: Two boys from very different Jewish communities become friends in 1940s Brooklyn in this moving novel of fathers, sons, and silence.

education.ikinyarwanda: A complete guide to learning Kinyarwanda grammar and vocabulary, perfect for students and beginners.
education.historyRwanda: A detailed historical study of Rwanda from ancient times to the modern era.
education.basicHealth: A practical health reference covering first aid, hygiene, and community health topics.
education.englishGrammar: A clear, self-study grammar book with simple explanations and exercises — a trusted companion for learners at every level.
education.mathematics: Primary school mathematics made simple, with examples drawn from everyday life.
education.biology: An accessible biology textbook covering the human body, plants, and ecosystems with clear diagrams.
education.physics: Forces, motion, light, and energy explained with experiments that can be done at home.
education.chemistry: Atoms, elements, and reactions made understandable, with a strong emphasis on safety.
education.geography: The land, people, and climate of Rwanda and the wider region, presented with maps and illustrations.
education.civics: An introduction to the rights and duties of citizens and the institutions of the Republic of Rwanda.
education.enRwDictionary: A practical English–Kinyarwanda dictionary with thousands of words and example sentences.
education.frRwDictionary: A reliable French–Kinyarwanda dictionary for students, translators, and daily life.
education.historyAfrica: A rich introduction to the great civilizations of Africa and the making of the modern continent.
education.kiswahili: A beginner's course in Kiswahili with everyday dialogues and practical vocabulary.
education.writing: A practical guide to writing clearly and well — for students, professionals, and public life.

children.villageDog: Meet Buna, the friendly village dog who knows every path and proves that even a dog can be a hero.
children.bigBird: A bird with very big wings learns that what makes him different is exactly what keeps his friends safe.
children.goodChild: Amina shows that small daily acts of kindness are what make a truly good person.
children.caterpillar: A hungry caterpillar eats and eats until something wonderful happens — a favourite story of growth and change.
children.lionMouse: The classic fable of the tiny mouse who proves that small friends can be the greatest help.
children.folktales: Grandmothers' tales gathered beneath the giant tree — Rwandan stories with wisdom for every child.
children.alphabet: From A to Z, meet a friend for every letter in this bright and simple alphabet book.
children.numbers: Learn to count, to add, and to share fairly with the world of the village as your classroom.
children.aesop: The timeless fables of Aesop, retold simply — the tortoise, the crow, and all their clever friends.
children.gorilla: Follow silverback Mundo through the misty forest as he keeps his family safe — a story of love and protection.
children.rainbowFish: A beautiful fish learns that sharing its shining scales brings more joy than keeping them.
children.givingTree: The tender story of a tree and a boy, showing that the truest love gives without counting.
children.wildSwans: A brave sister weaves nettle shirts of silence to free her eleven brothers from a wicked spell.
children.littleRedHen: The little red hen plants, harvests, and bakes by herself — and learns who deserves to share the bread.

other.communityLeadership: A practical guide to community governance in Rwanda — dialogue, teamwork, and leading with integrity.
other.sportsHealth: Why sport keeps the body and mind healthy, with routines for everyone from beginner to athlete.
other.inspiringStories: Ordinary Rwandans who overcame great difficulty through courage and perseverance.
other.firstAid: A clear first aid manual: how to respond calmly and save a life when an accident happens.
other.farming: Modern farming techniques for Rwandan conditions — soil, seeds, water, and post-harvest care.
other.business: Turning a good idea into a sustainable small business, written for young entrepreneurs.
other.nutrition: A balanced plate for every budget: how to eat well and protect the health of the whole family.
other.environment: Why the climate is changing and what every citizen can do — planting trees, saving water, reducing waste.
other.soccer: A coaching manual for young players, covering skills, tactics, fitness, and patience.
other.rwandaHeroes: The lives and values of Rwanda's heroes — ordinary people who chose to serve above themselves.
other.savings: How to start and run a community savings group, the first bridge to financial security.
other.parenting: Supporting parents from infancy to adolescence with practical, caring guidance.
other.peacebuilding: Peace as daily practice — dialogue, justice, and reconciliation in Rwandan communities.
other.umuganda: The communal work day and what it truly means: solidarity and shared responsibility.
